mentions.name: MyJackfruit
mentions.description: AI-powered app-building platform positioned as a competitor to Lovable and base44 that builds production-level apps in weeks (simple apps in a couple of hours) rather than quick prototypes. Development of each app uses Systems Engineering, starting with mapping out all stakeholders and quantifying product values, and the AI codes against those quantified stakeholder and product values instead of a prompt. Apps rest on a foundation that is scalable, secure, fast, access-controlled, and ontology-based with a focus on data ownership, and developers can use GitHub and all their tools.
mentions.problem: Existing AI app builders like Lovable and base44 produce prototypes in minutes rather than production-level apps.
